nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Sam sees the giant pumpkin in the class garden has a big bite taken out of it. The class is excited. Sam wants to find out who did it without scaring any animal away.'>>

choices.label: Look for clues around the pumpkin
Ask a friend what they saw

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=72 beats='Sam kneels by the pumpkin. The dirt shows tiny footprints leading away. A few fur strands hang on a rough edge of the fence.'>>

choices.label: Check the fence for more fur
Look under the big leaf nearby
Follow the tiny footprints

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Sam runs to find Mia. Mia says she saw something brown near the pumpkin at sunset. She thinks it might be a rabbit or a squirrel.'>>

choices.label: Plan to watch at sunset with a snack
Check the compost heap for nibble marks

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Sam finds more fur on the fence. It is soft and gray. A small hole near the ground could be an entrance.'>>

choices.label: Carefully collect the fur to show the class
Look for footprints on the other side

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='Under the big leaf, Sam finds a small tunnel of trampled grass. A single acorn lies nearby.'>>

choices.label: Hide under the leaf and wait
Gently lift the leaf to see what is underneath

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=66 beats='Sam follows the footprints past the bean poles and around a puddle. They lead toward the old stone wall.'>>

choices.label: Follow the trail to the garden shed
Follow the trail to the stone wall

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=60 beats='Sam and Mia sit quietly behind the big bush. The sun sets. They watch the pumpkin. Soon they see a small shape hop out.'>>

choices.label: Whipser to take a picture
Stay very still and watch

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=62 beats='At the compost heap, Sam sees fresh nibbles on a carrot top. Something is hiding behind the pile.'>>

choices.label: Peek behind the pile
Sprinkle seeds to lure it out

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=60 beats='Sam examines the fur with a magnifying glass. It matches the class pet rabbit that escaped last week. The nibbler is Fluffy!'>>

choices.label: Run to tell the teacher
Try to catch Fluffy gently

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='On the other side of the fence, Sam sees tiny footprints going toward the wildflower patch. Some flowers are bent.'>>

choices.label: Follow the bent flowers
Go back and try a different clue

nodes.body: <<FILL role=watcher words=68 beats='Sam hides under the leaf and waits. After a while, a squirrel comes to nibble on an acorn. It does not see the pumpkin.'>>

choices.label: Watch the squirrel some more
Sneak out and check other spots

nodes.body: <<FILL role=reveal words=66 beats='Sam lifts the leaf carefully. A small rabbit is munching a fallen pumkin chunk. It looks up with big eyes.'>>

choices.label: Stay very still and smile
Whisper hello to the rabbit

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='The tracks lead to the garden shed. The door is slightly open. A tuft of fur is on the doorframe.'>>

choices.label: Peek inside carefully
Call out softly

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=64 beats='The trail ends at a hole under the wall. Inside the hole, something rustles. Sam hears tiny crunching sounds.'>>

choices.label: Peek into the hole
Leave a small piece of apple near the hole

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Sam snaps a photo just as the animal turns. It is a baby sqirrel with a pumkin seed in its mouth. The picture is perfect!'>>

choices.label: Show the photo to the class
Keep watching quietly

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Sam watches as a rabbit hops up to the pumpkin and nibbles a piece. It is very gentle. Sam feels happy to see it.'>>

choices.label: Whisper to Mia that it is a rabbit
Watch a little longer

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=64 beats='Behind the pile, a hedgehog is munching on a fallen apple. It snorts and rolls into a ball.'>>

choices.label: Carefully tell your friends
Leave it alone and come back later

nodes.body: <<FILL role=wait words=60 beats='Sam sprinkles seeds and steps back. A squirrel darts out, grabs a seed, and scampers away. Not a nibbler after all.'>>

choices.label: Try luring with something else
Give up and go inside

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=58 beats='Sam quietly creeps out from under the leaf and goes back to the pumpkin patch to think.'>>

choices.label: Check the compost heap
Ask a different friend

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='Sam returns to the pumpkin and sees a new nibble mark. Maybe it is a bird? Sam notices a blue jay on the fence.'>>

choices.label: Watch the blue jay for a while
Climb on the fence to see better
